answer.book: Leovardiae 1646 edition of Pierius Winsemius's Latin history of Frisia (Historiarum ab excessu Caroli V. Caesaris, sive rerum sub Philippo II. per Frisiam gestarum), in seven books, preceded by dedication, commendatory poems and epitaph, and followed by a second work, Martinus à Wybinga's funeral oration on Winsemius, and an index; the books contain headed documents (edicts, decrees, letters) and inscriptions.
